mode: read-only exact-source audit; no native suite or race execution claimed
provenance_check: The earlier unarchived daemon working copy contained an extra trailing newline and failed Git-blob verification. It is excluded. The canonical connector-byte copy from abort-review is verified against eed817dcac736beded62ad83c2cbb908936370e4.

evidence: FleetRegistry contains only layout. compare_and_transition reads a generation and publishes the next lifecycle file using hard_link.
run_supervisord_inner acquires its private Unix SingleInstanceLock before Supervisor::recover and serializes RPC/tick via Mutex.
Public Supervisor::recover itself accepts a plain FleetRegistry without an owner-lock token.
findings.conclusion: Single-file lifecycle CAS and daemon-local serialization do not establish exclusion spanning all public library instances and durable state files.

evidence: read_intent validates schema/identity digest. Intent digest includes status and grant fields.
write_intent checks one existing grant and atomically replaces the file; it does not CAS the observed full intent digest, lifecycle generation, lease or transaction snapshot.
The inspect/abort CLI reads an exact intent digest and only publishes an Abort directive. It does not hold the supervisor owner lock or itself establish terminal Aborted.
findings.conclusion: An exact digest and atomic publication cannot substitute for exclusive ownership plus revalidation across the full critical section.

evidence: recover_signed_intent returns early only for Committed/RolledBack and otherwise rewrites to RecoveryRequired if no terminal transaction witness resolves it.
Ordinary daemon mutations other than emergency Kill consult that predicate.
findings.conclusion: Adding Aborted to the early-return list alone can remove the signed-intent quarantine while a separate release fence is unresolved.

evidence: preflight_start checks active Agent runtime, Agent lease and Failed/Stopped lifecycle, with no nonterminal release transaction check.
Public start/start_release call start_release_slot; that helper checks runtime, lease and lifecycle before CAS to Starting and spawn.
preflight_upgrade has an explicit nonterminal transaction/release-change/restart-pending guard.
findings.conclusion: Aborted terminality and permission to Start must remain separate. A blanket transaction rejection in the shared internal spawn helper could break authorized upgrade/rollback paths; distinguish explicit starts from the owner state machine.

evidence: ManagedProcess contract in driver.rs says every method must return promptly and never wait for process exit.
matrix.rs recover_matrix_companion: the non-running-Agent Adoption::Adopted branch calls kill, then removes the Matrix lease and drops the process handle.
tick_matrix_companion takes the runtime out of the slot and has early question-mark returns on kill/poll errors before restoring the handle.
The Agent signed-intent quarantine path instead retains its runtime in RuntimePhase::Killing after issuing kill.
findings.conclusion: A new Abort absence check would be unsound on the Matrix recovery path: kill success is not observed exit. Retain a fenced observable Matrix handle and lease until poll/adoption establishes termination; preserve the handle and a retryable fence on errors.

static_race_scenario.classification: reasoned interleaving from source, not an executed production race
steps: Recovery A reads Failed/Stopped, no runtime/lease, an exact recovery intent and no unresolved transaction.
Another public Supervisor instance B advances lifecycle and spawns through its unlocked library path.
A merely replacing the intent with Aborted cannot detect that intervening change; a CAS on a separate lifecycle file does not couple these operations.
static_race_scenario.required_prevention: A common owner lock or equivalent fencing/transaction protocol covering all cooperating writers and the full check-to-publication interval.

minimum_safe_candidate_scope: Use one lifetime-held supervisor owner exclusion for daemon and public recovery, or an equivalently enforceable owner token; inventory every writer and avoid a temporary lock that is released while a mutable Supervisor remains live.

Within the same protected operation, verify the exact current intent/directive binding, Agent identity, lifecycle/generation, absence of Agent/Matrix live handles and unresolved leases, and absence of unresolved release transactions. Persist only the intended Abort.
Keep Aborted terminal on later recovery while independently enforcing release/restart/process fences on RPC and public Start paths. Do not clear an unrelated fence.
Retain Agent/Matrix process observability after kill, including failure paths. Only confirmed Exited/Missing can establish absence.

Run native cases for competing ownership, stale digest/generation, live/terminating Agent and Matrix, leases, unresolved release transactions and second recovery after Abort. Preserve successful authorized release transitions.
